learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to define the production operation regarding political, economic, and business criteria and to evaluate its performance and position in the industrial environment.
Students are able to structure and optimize the operation with regard to production goals using various classification functions.
Students are able to adapt the individual steps of technical order processing.
Students are able to apply various methods for investment planning, cost calculation, factory layout, machine utilization and capacity, product layout, and production flow.
Students are able to compare all relevant organizational forms of manufacturing and assembly and assess their suitability for a production task.

Students are able to describe the relevant controlling procedures for steering and monitoring all technical and personnel aspects from individual orders to production programs and from individual workstations to the factory.

syllabus_topics: The industrial enterprise in modern society
Structure and function in industrial enterprises
